title: Following up quotes
body: Every quote you send gets a friendly check-in after 3 days and a last nudge after a week, so none go cold. The same works for new sign-ups: a welcome email, something useful a few days later, and a nudge if they go quiet.

title: Replying to new enquiries
body: Enquiries from your website, Facebook and Instagram land in one list, tagged with where they came from. Each gets a reply within minutes in your own words, and you can see who still needs a call.

title: Posting on social media
body: Write a month of posts in one sitting and pick the days. They go out to each channel on schedule while you're on the tools.

title: Chasing unpaid invoices
body: When a job is marked done, the invoice goes out. Unpaid after 7 days, a polite reminder follows, then another at 14 (you set the timings). Payments that land are matched to the right invoice.

title: Booking and rescheduling
body: Customers pick a slot from your real availability, get a confirmation straight away and a reminder the day before. They can move or cancel without ringing you.

title: Answering the same questions
body: Questions that come in by email, form or DM get a reply built from answers you've already approved. Anything new or unusual comes straight to you, with the message attached. Not a chatbot.

title: Asking for reviews
body: A day or two after the job, the customer gets a short message with a one-tap link to your Google reviews. One reminder if they don't respond, then it stops.

title: Low-stock alerts
body: Set a minimum for each product. When stock drops below it, you get a text or email saying what's low and how fast it's been selling.

title: Order and delivery updates
body: Customers get an email when they order, when it ships with tracking, and when it's delivered. That's most "where's my order?" messages gone.

title: Pulling numbers together
body: Sales, enquiries and where they came from, in one short report every Monday morning or whenever suits. No logging in to five dashboards.
